name: codex-native-provider-picker
goal: Prove the installed native picker routes Claude selections through the local gateway and OpenAI selections through the native subscription provider, preserves the same chat and keeps OpenAI as default

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: User authorized a separate native app copy on 2026-10-09 after installed-client routing probes failed. Scope preserves the original app, native OpenAI default, Claude-only localhost gateway, same-thread verified cold switching, first desktop acceptance gate and honest unsupported-feature boundaries.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Separate signed native desktop copy installed on macOS, pinned to 26.1002.52244. NativePickerBridgeService/DefaultsService/SwitchService bind model to provider, isolate picker defaults, preserve same thread, reject active/interrupted and connected remote state, verify cold resume and rollback. ASAR integrity remains enabled; original app signature verifies. Native Claude tool and same-chat round trip passed; hosted web search is explicitly unavailable for Claude.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Unchanged red-to-green regressions captured in ignored desktop-copy evidence. Focused tests cover ASAR contents/integrity, unknown asset rejection, native catalog/model routing, defaults preservation, same-thread serialization, idle/interrupted/failed-turn guards, rollback, history listing, cold resume and Claude hosted-tool isolation. Latest bun run check passed: 239 CLI unit tests, 52 CLI E2E tests, 88 report tests plus build smoke; 25 opt-in live tests skipped.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: bun run check passed (desktop-copy/verified-check.log). Actual native trial 01a120f2-3287-71b0-99f9-25c4dcc700d9 streamed Claude commentary; Codex executed printf with correlated output and exit 0; follow-up remembered KIWI_953; native Claude/OpenAI/Claude round trip preserved the same chat and marker. After app restart, Recents reopened the Claude chat and stable LaunchAgent gateway 47841 returned another Codex tool output. Fresh native-picker-green.png and native-roundtrip-green.png captured and inspected. Original and copy strict signatures verified; original OpenAI defaults preserved. Hosted web search disabled for Claude; phone/voice untested. No paid fallback or public deployment.

verificationNotes: Native delivery gate passed in the separately signed Codex Harness Experimental copy, desktop 26.1002.52244 / bundled 0.162.0-alpha.2. Synthetic trial 01a120f2-3287-71b0-99f9-25c4dcc700d9 proved streamed Claude commentary, Codex terminal execution with exit 0, follow-up marker recall and native Claude/OpenAI/Claude round trip. App restart restored the chat and Claude selection; persistent LaunchAgent gateway 47841 executed another Codex terminal call. Fresh screenshots and trace/check evidence are ignored under .cache/codex-picker-evidence/desktop-copy/. bun run check passed. Original bundle and defaults preserved. Hosted web_search is disabled for Claude; phone and voice remain untested. Original vendor app still requires provider-aware changes; this experimental copy provides them without changing the vendor bundle.
